Tom Select 2.6.2 (Apache-2.0)

The JavaScript, stylesheet, and LICENSE in this directory are unmodified files
from the published `tom-select@2.6.2` npm package. The JavaScript is the base
bundle; Resonance does not use Tom Select plugins. They are served locally so
the UI needs neither a CDN nor a Node build step at runtime.
The base bundle includes `@orchidjs/sifter` and `@orchidjs/unicode-variants`,
both licensed under Apache-2.0.
